descripcion_geo: Geopolitical entity in the extreme north mentioned in Ezekiel 38-39 and in the Apocalypse; identified with the Scythian peoples or with an eschatological symbol.
importancia_estrategica: Symbol of the hostile power of the north that will attack Israel in the time of the end; eschatological name par excellence.

historias.descripcion: Ezekiel prophesies that 'Gog of the land of Magog, prince of Ros, Meshech and Tubal' will invade Israel in the last days, but God will destroy him.

historias.titulo: Gog's Defeat: The Birds and the Beasts
historias.descripcion: Gog's army will be destroyed in the mountains of Israel; the birds and beasts will devour their carcasses at God's great feast.

historias.titulo: Gog and Magog in the Apocalypse
historias.descripcion: At the end of the millennium, Satan will gather the nations 'Gog and Magog' for the final battle; They will be consumed by fire from heaven.

personajes.descripcion: Symbol of the enemy power of God and Israel in eschatological time.
He spoke the most detailed oracles of the OT against Gog and Magog.
He resumed the names Gog and Magog from Ezekiel for the final eschatological battle.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Gog (Land of Magog): relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: Gog and Magog: the final enemy

judaismo.descripcion: Ezekiel's prophecy about Gog is the greatest eschatological vision of the OT: the final attack against Israel ends with the miraculous destruction of the enemy.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Ezekiel's prophecy about Gog is the greatest eschatological vision of the OT: the final attack against Israel ends with the miraculous destruction of the enemy.

cristianismo.descripcion: The Revelation identifies Gog and Magog with all the nations that Satan gathers for the final battle before universal judgment (Rev 20:7-10).
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Revelation identifies Gog and Magog with all the nations that Satan gathers for the final battle before universal judgment (Rev 20:7-10).

islam.descripcion: Islam identifies Yajuj and Majuj (Gog and Magog) with people of the end who will be liberated before the day of judgment (Cor 18:94-98).
islam.significado_teologico: Islam identifies Yajuj and Majuj (Gog and Magog) with people of the end who will be liberated before the day of judgment (Cor 18:94-98).
